about.lines: HITRAN2020 via RADIS 0.17.1, Voigt lines, isotopologues 1–3, 0.01 cm⁻¹ grid, no continuum, no line mixing
about.atmosphere: US Standard Atmosphere 1976, 26 layers from 0 to 60 km; water vapour and ozone profiles after AFGL US Standard, scaled to 25 kg m⁻² and 300 DU; CO₂ 428 ppm, CH₄ 1939 ppb, N₂O 340 ppb
about.ultraviolet: O₃ Hartley, Huggins and Chappuis bands from Serdyuchenko et al. (2014) cross-sections at 223 K; below 0.2 μm O₂ and O₃ are set opaque
about.rayleigh: Bodhaine et al. (1999) eq. 30 for a vertical column at sea level, extrapolated as λ⁻⁴ below 0.2 μm
about.binning: mean transmittance over 3000 log-spaced wavelength bins, 0.05 to 100.0 μm, 3 decimals
